question: Which of the following musical instruments does Ustad Amjad Ali Khan play?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sarod**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **21st Rajiv Gandhi National Sadbhavna Award **went to **Khan**.
 
• In **1975, 1991, and 2001**, he also **earned the Padma Shri **and the **Padma Bhushan awards**.
 
• **Sarod**
 
 
• It is a **stringed instrument**.
 
• It is one of the most well-known and renowned instruments, along with the sitar.
 
• The sarod is renowned for its profound, substantial, and reflective tone.
 
• It is frequently utilised in the state's folk music. ​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ustad Bismillah Khan **was born on **21 March 1916 **in **Dumaron, Bihar**. He was **the famous Shehnai player of India**.
 
• **One of the greatest sitar musicians of the latter part of the 20th century was Pandit Ravi Shankar.**
 
• **Zakir Hussain is **a recipient of the Padma Bhushan, Padma Shri, and Sangeet Natak Akademi Awards. He is arguably India's most well-known **tabla virtuoso in the post-independence era**.
